newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Reef Casino to seek extra capital.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Reef Casino to seek extra capital.

text.p: Reef Casino Trust said the board of Reef Corporate Services Ltd, the trust's manager, unanimously agreed on Friday with the trust founders and the hotel and casino lessees on a process to seek additional capital for the trust and a timetable for implementation.
The process would be conducted by the trust's advisers, Grant Samuel & Associates, it said.
The board is seeking approval for the process from its financiers and the trustee, the trust said.
An application to lift the suspension of the trust's units will be made next week after completion of formal documentation.
The units were suspended from the start of trading on Tuesday at the request of the manager of the trust.
Late last month, financiers withdrew a A$15 million external working capital facility used to fund high-rolling gambler visits to the Reef Casino at Cairns in north Queensland.

The operator of the loss-making casino, Casinos Austria International Ltd (CAI), said last week that junket and premium player gaming at the casino would not be available until further notice as a result.
